description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'ConsistentRingProvider' which implements ring-based consistent hashing for silo address management in Orleans. It manages a ring of silo nodes, handles server addition/removal, computes responsible nodes for keys, and notifies listeners of range changes.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Implements a ring-based consistent hashing mechanism for managing silo addresses, handling server membership, and range notifications within Orleans.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Returns the primary owner silo for a given key based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Returns the current range of responsibility for this silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to range change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from range change notifications.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles status changes of silos, updating membership and ranges accordingly.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from silo status events and cleans up resources.
